newsitem.title: USA: BPA raises Wed peak firm prices by $2.50/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA raises Wed peak firm prices by $2.50/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer 200 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Wednesday, but raised prices by $2.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.
BPA offered Wednesday firm power during peak demand hours at $16.50 per MWh in the Northwest and at $17.50 at the California Oregon Border (COB).
The prices are up $4.00 per MWh from prescheduled Monday deliveries.
Unlimited light-load firm power was unchanged for Wednesday at $9.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100 to 0500 and 2400 PDT on Wednesday were also unchanged at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 was unchanged at $10.00.
